Nobody knows why she became associated with the phrase, but, as a result, people today believe she was a cruel and thoughtless woman. However, historical documents show a much different side of Marie Antoinette. For instance, there is a letter she wrote to her family in Austria to describe an ongoing food shortage in France. In the letter, she wrote, "It is quite certain that in seeing the people who treat us so well despite their own misfortune, we are more obliged than ever to work hard for their happiness."
